title: Vibe Coding for Lawyers: Build Legal Tools Without Hiring a Developer
summary: Lawyers are building case trackers, contract templates, client portals, and billing dashboards without a dev team. Here's what works, what doesn't, and how to start.
body_markdown: Internal tools (matter trackers, time entry, CLE tracking) are straightforward. Client-facing tools that store communications or privileged documents require more care: use a platform with proper security, review your state bar's technology rules, and consider a disclosure to clients. Blink uses HTTPS and proper auth by default, which satisfies standard requirements for operational tools.
